summary: All amounts are in United States dollars, unless otherwise stated. TORONTO, Nov. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Alamos Gold Inc. (TSX:AGI; NYSE:AGI) (“Alamos” or the “Company”) today announced that the Company's Board of Directors has declared a quarterly dividend of US$0.04 per common share.
title: Alamos Gold Declares Quarterly Dividend

summary: PITTSBURGH, Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- FirstService Residential, North America's leading residential community management company, has been selected to provide full-service property management for Bower Hill, a luxury high-rise community in the Mt. Lebanon section of Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania.
title: FirstService Residential Selected to Manage Bower Hill at Mt. Lebanon, Expanding Its Pittsburgh High-Rise Presence

summary: HACKENSACK, N.J., Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- FirstService Residential, North America's leading residential community management company, is proud to announce that it has been selected to provide full-service property management for Executive House, a distinguished high-rise community in Hackensack, New Jersey.
title: FirstService Residential Expands Its New Jersey Footprint, Welcoming Executive House in Hackensack, NJ

summary: MIAMI, Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Restaurant Brands International Inc. (NYSE: QSR) (TSX: QSR) (TSX: QSP) ("RBI") announced today that Josh Kobza, Chief Executive Officer, and Sami Siddiqui, Chief Financial Officer, will participate in a fireside chat at Morgan Stanley Global Consumer & Retail Conference in New York on December 2, 2026 at 9:30am Eastern Time. A live audio webcast will be available on the company's investor relations website (http://rbi.com/investors) and a replay will be available for a limited time following the event.
title: Restaurant Brands International Inc. to Participate in Morgan Stanley Global Consumer & Retail Conference
